messages:
sachin: handing off — heads up for midnight shift. GPU pools stable but watch Pool-Embed and Pool-Gen. current numbers: Pool-Embed 68% util (5m avg), Pool-Gen 81% util. burst tokens: Pool-Embed 3/5, Pool-Gen 1/5.

sachin: active customers spiking: acme-inc embeddings job started at 11:22pm (long jobs, high seq len). they account for ~28% of embed tokens in last 30m.

sachin: small risk: we have a canary rollout of quantized-v2 on gen-service that will finish at 01:00. if that increases per-token latency we might see queueing into Pool-Gen. keep an eye on gen p95 and cell queue length.

emily: thanks — taking midnight. quick Q: do we want to proactively expand Pool-Gen burst to 2 tokens from 1? or should we hold?

sachin: recommend +1 to Pool-Gen burst if we see sustained >78% for 10m. otherwise hold. I bumped concurrency on embed workers earlier to 6 which reduced headroom, so be cautious.

emily: copy. will watch p95 and queued-requests. if p95 > 450ms and util > 85% for 5m, i will escalate and increase burst.

marcus: ping — I can remote-in if you need to scale pools manually. my note: infra autoscale cooldown is 3m, and swap-on-full is off for Pool-Embed (we disabled automatic swap during the last deploy).

lara: FYI I left a runbook tweak in the oncall doc: added the PromQL queries we use for util and queue. snippet below:
```
# 5m average GPU util per pool
avg_over_time(gpu_utilization_percent{pool="Pool-Embed"}[5m])
# queued requests for gen service
sum(queue_length{service="gen-service"})
```

emily: thanks lara — saving.

oncall-bot: reminder: reserved-capacity alert threshold at 80% reached for us-west-2 on 1774123400.

infra-bot: deploy completed: gen-service quantized-v2 canary -> 10% traffic at 1774124200 :rocket:

emily: seeing a small bump in gen p95 right after canary traffic cut. p95 from 320ms -> 440ms, util up 3 points. watching for 10m.

sachin: good catch. if p95 stays above 420ms for another 5m and queue > 50, flip canary back or increase Pool-Gen burst. I prefer increase burst first (safer).

emily: increased Pool-Gen burst to 2 via rwctl: `rwctl pool set-burst --pool Pool-Gen --tokens 2` — monitor for 2m. :eyes:

emily: after 3m: p95 dropped to 360ms, queue down to 18. util back to 79%. leaving burst=2 for now.

marcus: noted — re-enabled swap-on-full for Pool-Embed at 1774125000. that should help if ACME jobs spike further.

sachin: thanks all. handoff complete — Marcus taking the 03:00-07:00 window, emily on until 02:30 then marcus. if anything odd, DM or page. leaving the alert escalation set to pager at util>90% or queue>200.

marcus: taking it. good summary. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: handoff logged by sachin at 1774125500.

emily: closing thread on my side, will post follow-up if anything changes.

sachin: cheers, glhf.
